Ranks Montgomery census tracts by 2025 code violations per 1,000 residents using pre-aggregated tract counts left-joined to CDC PLACES population, with null rates last and geoid retained for mapping.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_42fb27' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
population AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_42fb27_population_cdc
)
SELECT t.name,
       CASE WHEN p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
            THEN (COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) / p.totalpopulation) * 1000.0
       END AS violations_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       COALESCE(v.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
       p.totalpopulation,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN violations v ON t.geoid = v.geoid
LEFT JOIN population p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
ORDER BY violations_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
